meta.title: Lantai session attribution
meta.description: Adds the calling DSH session and tool-call ID to each Lantai MCP request. In Plugins, configure the disabled connection, disable the existing include:mcp-lantai entry, then enable this plugin. Uses static transport settings; credential templates, MCP resources, and server instructions are unsupported. Turning it off closes its connection and removes its tools. Attribution labels never grant access.
